summary: Capture a gallon by voice in your connected Google Sheet.
description: 50-A voice capture is a private proof of concept for recording water gallons in a configured Google Sheet. Say "Alexa, open apartment ledger," then say "add a gallon." You can also ask for help or say stop. Google Sheets setup is required. Entries are not yet synced into the 50-A app.
examplePhrases: Alexa, tell apartment ledger to add a gallon
Alexa, ask apartment ledger for help
